description:
In this compelling episode of "A Wolf in Sheep’s Clothing," you are in for a powerful testimony as Mikey Jenny, a content creator from Little Light Studios, shares his personal journey of faith. Join us as Mikey opens up about how his involvement with media initially led him down a path to the occult. Delve into the challenges he faced and the spiritual battles he encountered in the world of media.
